Bounty - Easy (Criminal).giver: Crusader Security / Hurston Dynamics Security / ArcCorp Security / NRCE
Bounty - Easy (Criminal).description: Mark and eliminate or capture a single low-threat wanted criminal operating in the Stanton system.
Bounty - Easy (Criminal).tips: Target is typically a solo ship. Scan to confirm identity, then disable or destroy. Bring a light fighter.

Bounty - Medium (Criminal).giver: UEE Advocacy / Crusader Security / Hurston Dynamics Security
Bounty - Medium (Criminal).description: Pursue and neutralise a medium-threat criminal. May have escort ships or enhanced shields.
Bounty - Medium (Criminal).tips: Target often has a wing of 1–2 escorts. Clear escorts first. Scan target before engaging to confirm.

Bounty - Hard (High Value Target).description: Eliminate a high-value target with multiple escorts and enhanced combat capability.
Bounty - Hard (High Value Target).tips: HVT usually spawns with 3–5 escort ships. Bring a capable fighter or fly with a crew. Target flees when disabled.

Bounty - Very Hard (Elite).description: Locate and neutralise an elite-tier target. Heavily armoured ship, multiple AI escorts, possible countermeasures.
Bounty - Very Hard (Elite).ship_required: Heavy multicrew or wing of fighters
Bounty - Very Hard (Elite).tips: Use missiles to strip shields quickly. Assign crew to turrets. Beware of ECM and chaff. These pay out well.

Cargo — Local Delivery.description: Transport a small cargo of goods from one location to another within a time limit.
Cargo — Local Delivery.tips: Plan route using mobiGlas. Check transit time vs. deadline. Cargo is pre-loaded — just land at destination.

Cargo — Long-Haul Delivery.description: Transport a large volume of cargo across multiple planetary bodies or between distant stations.
Cargo — Long-Haul Delivery.tips: High piracy risk on long routes. Stanton→Pyro routes pay significantly more. Consider an escort.

Cargo — Cross-System (Stanton to Pyro).description: Transport cargo between Stanton and Pyro through the Stanton–Pyro jump point. High piracy risk.
Cargo — Cross-System (Stanton to Pyro).tips: Jump point is heavily contested by pirates. Fly a fast ship. Avoid known piracy corridors when possible.

Data Running — Collect & Deliver.description: Travel to a specified location, hack or collect a data chip, and return it to the mission giver.
Data Running — Collect & Deliver.tips: Use a multitool with the PCA attachment to hack terminals. Watch for security guards at secured locations.

Delivery — Small Package.description: Deliver a small package or parcel to a specified individual or drop box within a time limit.
Delivery — Small Package.tips: Some packages are fragile — avoid rough landings. Check deadline carefully. Great for quick aUEC farming.

Delivery — Multi-Stop.description: Deliver multiple packages to different locations in sequence, each with an individual deadline.
Delivery — Multi-Stop.tips: Optimise route order to hit all deadlines. Plan hyperjump sequence to minimise transit time.

Escort — Ship Convoy.description: Escort civilian or commercial ships through pirate-heavy zones to their destination.
Escort — Ship Convoy.tips: Stay close to the convoy. Pirates spawn at ambush points. Prioritise fast neutralisation of aggressors.

Ground Combat — Outpost Assault.description: Clear a hostile-occupied outpost of criminals, Nine Tails, or Vanduul operatives.
Ground Combat — Outpost Assault.tips: Use FPS loadout: light-medium armour, rifle, sidearm. Clear exterior then interior. Watch for snipers on towers.

Ground Combat — UGF (Underground Facilit.description: Infiltrate and clear a defended underground facility. Multiple floors, entrenched enemies. High reward.
Ground Combat — UGF (Underground Facilit.tips: Bring heavy armour, medical pen, rifle + shotgun. Coordinate choke points. Enemies respawn if too slow.

Mining — Hand Mining.description: Use a mining multitool attachment to extract surface deposits from cave floors or asteroid faces.
Mining — Hand Mining.location: Moon caves — Daymar, Cellin, Yela, Euterpe
Mining — Hand Mining.tips: Caves on Daymar contain Hadanite and Aphorite. Watch for Cave Lurkers (Grabbers). Best done with a buddy.

Mining — Ship Mining (Solo).description: Use a Prospector or Mole to locate and extract valuable ore from asteroid rings or planet surfaces.
Mining — Ship Mining (Solo).location: Stanton asteroid belts / Yela belt / Aaron Halo
Mining — Ship Mining (Solo).tips: Quantanium is most valuable but unstable — refine quickly. Rigler XL + Surge consumable is meta for MOLE.

Patrol — Security.description: Patrol a designated zone and eliminate any hostile contacts encountered.
Patrol — Security.tips: Hostiles are typically pirate AI fighters. Quick to complete. Stack multiple patrol contracts for efficiency.

Recon — Scan & Report.description: Travel to designated points of interest, scan objects or wreckage, and transmit data.
Recon — Scan & Report.tips: Use your ship's scanning system (V key). Get within scanning range and hold. No combat usually required.

Salvage — ECN Distress Beacon.description: Respond to an emergency beacon, salvage the wreck, and optionally rescue survivors.
Salvage — ECN Distress Beacon.tips: Carry a med pen. Some wrecks have cargo. Sell salvage materials (RMC, CF) at TDD terminals.

Salvage — Derelict Reclamation.description: Locate and strip a designated derelict ship or station hull for reclaimed construction materials.
Salvage — Derelict Reclamation.tips: RMC and CF are the primary yield. Hull scraping earns more over time than tractor-beam grabs for small wrecks.

Medical — Emergency Response.description: Respond to an incapacitated player beacon, retrieve the player, and transport to a medical facility.
Medical — Emergency Response.tips: Carry medical supplies. ASOP beacons pay a reward. A medical bed is required to revive downed players.

Nine Tails — Illegal Supply Run.description: Transport illegal cargo (stims, weapons, slam) from a pick-up point to a Nine Tails drop zone.
Nine Tails — Illegal Supply Run.tips: Illegal cargo increases crime stat on security scan. Avoid Crusader Security checkpoints. Access from Grim HEX.

Xenothreat — Defend Station (Event).description: Xenothreat forces attack Orison platforms. Defend the station and assault their command ship.
Xenothreat — Defend Station (Event).tips: Timed event — check alerts. Group effort. Destroy boarding craft first, then assault the Idris command vessel.

Pyro — Outpost Assault.description: Assault hostile-controlled outposts in the Pyro system. Higher risk from environmental hazards and PVP.
Pyro — Outpost Assault.tips: Pyro has no safe zones. Expect PvP threat at all times. Heavy FPS armour recommended. Watch for environmental hazards.

Investigation — Personal.description: Locate clues at marked sites, scan for evidence, and report findings to the mission giver.
Investigation — Personal.tips: Use orange ping to locate clues. No combat required for most missions. Good for lore and storyline engagement.

Espionage — Counter Intelligence.description: Infiltrate a location, collect data or items, and exfiltrate without triggering a full alert.
Espionage — Counter Intelligence.tips: Stealth approach recommended. Subdue guards non-lethally. Ghost armour and suppressed weapons are ideal.
